[LDET.2.2b] **Engine cloning preserves the full "starting engine state," so
the clone is byte-identical.** Because clone deep-copies the mutable state and
continues every counter ([IARC.11]) — including the series backings and the
reservoir PRNG that [LDET.2.2a] names as engine state — a clone taken mid-run and
driven with the same input sequence produces a **byte-identical** observable
stream to the source (the equivalence half of the [NLFC.8.1] contract; 0-ULP,
even cross-platform in v1). Determinism *is* the test: **one conformance fixture
MUST pin the clone-diverge-compare check** — clone mid-run, drive `src` and the
clone with an identical input sequence, assert their observable streams are
byte-identical and that freeing one leaves the other fully functional — so clone
cannot silently rot.
